content: Isa edde he Sameriyo mayafuwawa
Ehon, Malike zehon zani faijje ze Foroši okkole fuinnil, hibaye Yahyattuwaro beši sahabi banar edde torikotor gusol der,
(zodi o Isaye nize torikotor gusol no dito, kintu hibar sahabi okkole dito.)
Toi hiba Ehudiyattu giyegoi edde abar Galilot giye.
Zaite hibattu Sameriyar butottu di za foijje.
Toi hiba Sykar name Sameriyar ek šohorot, aiššiye; ziyan Yakube hibar fut Yusufore dilde zobinor hãse.
He zagat heṛe ugguwa Yakubor kuwa aššil. Fõtot zat maze Isa oran oiye, edde he kuwar ḍake boišše; ar hẽtte ṭaim onumanik dũijja.
Toi heṛe Sameriyattu ek mayafuwa fani tulito aišše, Isaye hibare hodde,

content.text: "Ãre fani fito de"

content: (Hibar sahabi okkole šohorot hána kinto gil.)
He Sameriyo mayafuwawaye hibare hodde, "Õne, ekzon Ihudi oiyore, ãi ekzon Sameriyar mayafuwa oiyore, ãttu kengori fani sor?" (Kiyollahoile Ihudi okkole Sameriyo okkol loi suwa fiya no gorito.)
Isaye zuwabe hibare hodde,

content.text: "Tui zodi zaniti Allar hadiya ki, edde hiba honnuwaye hor 'Ãre fani fito de', toile tui hibattu saiti, ar hibaye tore zinda fani dito."

content: Mayafuwawaye hodde, "Malik, õnottude fani tulibolla kissu nai ar kuwawa o mur. Toile he zinda fani hontu for?
Ãrar baf Yakubottuwaro ki õne mohan, edde ze ei kuwa ãrare diye, ar hibattu hiba nize edde hibar fuwain okkole, hibar zanuwaror záke fani fiye?"
Isaye zuwabe hibare hodde,

content.text: "Fottikiye ze ei fani fiyer hite abar tiraši oibo,
kintu ze honokiye ãi diyumde he fanittu fibo, hite ar honodin tiraši no oibo; ãi diyumde fani hin hitar dilor butore ũtari uṛede zonnar fani ḍoilla oibo, edde akeri zibon dibo."

content: Mayafuwawaye hibare hodde, "Malik, toile ei fani ãre do, zene ãttu ar tiraš no lage, ar fani tulibolla eṛe aiya no fore."
Isaye hibare hodde,

content.text: "Za, tor zamaire ḍaki loiagoi"

content: Mayafuwaye hodde, "Ãttu zamai nai." Isaye hibare hodde,

content.text: "'Ãttu zamai nai' hoyosde hiyan tui ṭik hois.
Kiyollahoile ei foijjonto tottu fãszon zamai aššil, ar ehon tottu ze ase, hite tor zamai no; tui hodde hiyan soiyi."

content: Mayafuwaye hodde, "Malik, ãi buzi faijji ze õne ekzon nobi.
Ãrar fordada okkole ei faharor uwore ebadot gorito, kintu tũwara ho ze zagat ebadot gora foribo hiyan oilde Zeruzalemot."
Isaye hibare hodde:

content.text: "Oh mayafuwa, ãrar hota biššaš gor, en ṭaim aiyer zẽtte tũwara, no ei faharot, no Zeruzalemot, Bafor ebadot goriba.
Tũwara ziyan no zano hiyanor ebadot goro; kintu ãra ziyan zani hiyanor ebadot gori, kiyollahoile uddar oilde Ihudi okkolor butottu.
Kintu en ṭaim aiyer, enki ehon he šomoi aigiyegoi zẽtte asol ebadot goroya okkole soiyit edde Ruhut Bafor ebadot goribo. Bafe o endilla ebadot goroya okkolore tuwa.
Allah oilde Ruh, ar hitara zara hibar ebadot gore, soiyit edde Ruhut ebadot gora foribo."

content: Mayafuwawaye hodde, "Ãi zani Messiyah aibo (zare Mosi ḍake). Hiba zẽtte aibo, hibaye ãrare hár kissu buzai dibo."
Toi Isaye hibare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi, ze tor loi hota hoir, ãi hiba."

content: Isa edde Sameriyo okkol
Hen šomot hibar sahabi okkol aišše, edde hibaye ekzon mayafuwa loi hota hodde dekiyore hitara ammuwak oiye. Tarfore o hitara honokiye no ho, "Õne ki sodde?" Ba "hibar loi kiyolla hota hor?"
Toi mayafuwawaye hibar gorawa felai raki šohoror butore giye, edde mainšore hodde,
"Aiyo, ekzon manušore sogai, ze ãi zaha kissu goijji, beggun ãre hoi diye; Iba ki hono Messiyah ne?"
Hitara šohorottu niyoli giye edde Isar hãse aišše.
Hen šomot hibar sahabi okkole hibare foriyad gori hodde, "Rabbi, kissu hó."
Isaye hitarare hodde:

content.text: "Ãttu háibolla en hána ase, zinor babute tũwara no zano."

content: Sahabi okkol ekzone oinno zonore howa hoi goijje, "Honokiye ki hibare háibolla kissu ani diye oitfare?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ze ãre defeṛaiye hibar issa falon gora edde hibar ham gori šeš gorifela oilde ãr hána.
Tũwara ki no ho ne, 'ehon o sair maš ase, tarfore gula daibar ainda aiyer'? Ãi tũwarare hoir, suk tuli maṭ okkolor mikka so, hin daibolla fagi dóla oiye.
Ze dar hite hitar beton far, ar akeri zibonolla gulagun dola gori raker, zene ze biz laga edde ze gula da, dunizone ekkui fũwati kuši gori fare.
Etolla ei bosongan soiyi, 'Ekzone laga ar ekzone da.'
Ãi tũwarare daito defeṛailam zinolla tũwara hono haṛoni no goro; haṛoni goijje oinno kiye, ar tũwara goillo hitarar haṛonir fošol daito."

content: 'Ãi zaha kissu goijji, beggun ãre hoi diye' he mayafuwawar ei gobar hotar zoriya he šohoror bout Sameriyo okkole Isar uwore biššaš ainne.
Toi hitara hibar hãse aišše edde hibare hitarar fũwati takibolla foriyad goijje; ar hiba heṛe dui din taikke.
Hibar hotar zoriya aro bout beši mainše biššaši oiye.
Hitara mayafuwaware hodde: "Ãra šude tor hotar zoriya biššaš ainnide no; kiyollahoile ãra nize hibar hota fuinni edde zani ze iba oilde soiyi duniyair he Uddargoroya."
Kofornahumot he raz hormosari
Dui din farai zaigoi bade Isaye hentu baisa diye edde Galilot giyegoi.
(Kiyollahoile hibaye nize goba dil ze ekzon nobi hibar nizor dešot ijjot no fa.)
Hiba zehon Galilot aišše, Galiliyo okkole hibare goisse, Zeruzalemot uddar idot hibaye goijjede hár kissu hitara dekiyore, kiyollahoile hitara o uddar idot gil.
Isa abar Galilor Kana farat giye, zeṛe hibaye fanire šoraf goijjil. Ar heṛe ek raz hormosari aššil, zar fute ošuk loi duk fat aššil.
Ehudiyattu Isa Galilot aišše funiyore hite hibar hãse aišše, edde foriyad goijje zene hiba hitar fũwati lamat za edde hitar futore aram gore, kiyollahoile hitarar foran zar zar oiye.
Toi Isaye hitare hodde:

content.text: "Sinno edde keramoti ham no dekile, tũwara biššaš no goriba."

content: He raz hormosariye hodde: "Malik, meherbani gori ãr fuwawa no morite aiyo."
Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Za, tor fut basibo."

content: Henot hite Isaye hoiyede hota biššaš goijje edde giyegoi.
Ar hite lamat zadde fõtot, hitar gulam okkole dola oiye edde hitar hãse hóbor diye ze hitar fuwawa baisse.
Hite hitarare hite hõtte bala oiye he babute zera goijje, ar hitara hitare hodde: "Gelde hailla ugguwa baze, hitattu zor sarigiyegoi."
Henot fuwawar bafe buzi faijje ze, ṭik he šomot Isaye hitare hoil,

content.text: "Za, tũwar fut basibo."

content: Toi hite edde hitar fura gór ṭiyaye biššaši oiye.
Ehudiyattu Galilot ai bade Isaye ei dusora bar keramoti ham goijjil.
